import json
from django.utils import timezone
from django.db.models import Count
from apps.catalog.models import Offer,OfferObservation,OfferCandidate,ProductFamily
from apps.catalog.services.public_eligibility import public_eligibility_q,is_ship_from_verified
from apps.catalog.services.weekly_discovery import WEEKLY_FAMILY_SLUGS,PENDING_CAP_PER_FAMILY
qs=Offer.objects.filter(public_eligibility_q()).distinct()
eligible=list(qs.only("id","ship_from_country","ship_from_verified_at"))
families=list(ProductFamily.objects.filter(slug__in=WEEKLY_FAMILY_SLUGS))
pending={x["product_family__slug"]:x["total"] for x in OfferCandidate.objects.filter(status="PENDING").values("product_family__slug").annotate(total=Count("id"))}
last={}
for obs in OfferObservation.objects.filter(offer_id__in=[o.id for o in eligible]).order_by("offer_id","-observed_at","-id").only("id","offer_id","availability","observed_at"):
    if obs.offer_id not in last:last[obs.offer_id]=obs
ans={"date_utc":timezone.now().isoformat(),"family_names":[f.slug for f in families],"offer_total":Offer.objects.count(),"offer_active":Offer.objects.filter(is_active=True).count(),"public_eligible":len(eligible),"public_origin_verified":sum(is_ship_from_verified(x) for x in eligible),"public_origin_unverified":sum(not is_ship_from_verified(x) for x in eligible),"latest_unknown_count":sum((last.get(o.id) is None or last[o.id].availability=="UNKNOWN") for o in eligible),"pending_by_operational_family":{s:pending.get(s,0) for s in WEEKLY_FAMILY_SLUGS},"paused_families":[s for s in WEEKLY_FAMILY_SLUGS if pending.get(s,0)>=PENDING_CAP_PER_FAMILY],"pending_total":OfferCandidate.objects.filter(status="PENDING").count(),"pending_retired":OfferCandidate.objects.filter(status="PENDING",product_family__status="RETIRED").count()}
print("CATALOG_JSON="+json.dumps(ans,sort_keys=True))
